description: The source traditions assign Venus and Saturn to different day/night temporal-strength categories, so the assignments cannot be treated as one corroborating rule.
why_they_differ: Phaladeepika IV.1 names Mars, Moon, and Venus as night-strong, while the Brihat Jataka candidate names Moon, Mars, and Saturn as night-strong; the source-specific variants are preserved without selecting a default.
user_facing_note: Expose the selected source variant; do not merge the temporal-strength lists.
